arxiv-2101-10519.title: PC4 at Age 40
arxiv-2101-10519.creator: Michael Freedman
arxiv-2101-10519.description: Abstract This article is not a proof of the Poincaré conjecture but a discussion of the proof, its context, and some of the people who played a prominent role. It is a personal, anecdotal account. There may be omission or transpositions as these recollections are 40 years old and not supported by contemporaneous notes, but memories feel surprisingly fresh.

arxiv-2102-11869.title: Magnetic order in van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS 4 : anisotropic H − T H-T phase diagrams and effects of pressure
arxiv-2102-11869.creator: Sergey L. Bud’ko 1,2 , Elena Gati 1,2 , Tyler J. Slade 1,2 , and Paul C. Canfield 1,2
arxiv-2102-11869.description: Abstract Single crystalline samples of the van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS 4 were studied by measurements of specific heat and comprehensive anisotropic temperature- and magnetic field- dependent magnetization. In addition, measurements of the heat capacity and magnetization were performed under pressures of up to ∼ 21 \sim 21 kbar and ∼ 14 \sim 14 kbar respectively.

In 2017, Chen and Zeng investigated the eigenvalues with higher order of the fractional Laplacian ( − Δ ) s | Ω \left.

arxiv-2111-12381.title: An infinite class of exact rotating black hole metrics of modified gravity
arxiv-2111-12381.creator: Victor I. Afonso, Gerardo Mora-Pérez, Gonzalo J. Olmo, Emanuele Orazi, Diego Rubiera-Garcia
arxiv-2111-12381.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Victor I. Afonso, Gerardo Mora-Pérez, Gonzalo J. Olmo, Emanuele Orazi, Diego Rubiera-Garcia. We build an infinite class of exact axisymmetric solutions of a metric-affine gravity theory, namely, Eddington-inspired Born-Infeld gravity, coupled to an anisotropic fluid as a matter source. The solution-generating method employed is not unique of this theory but can be extended to other Ricci-Based Gravity theories (RBGs), a class of theories built out of contractions of the Ricci tensor with the metric.

arxiv-2111-14413.creator: Albert Visser
arxiv-2111-14413.description: Abstract . In the present paper, we explore an idea of Harvey Friedman to obtain a coordinate-free presentation of consistency. Friedman shows that, over Peano Arithmetic, the consistency statement for a finitely axiomatised theory A A can be characterised as the weakest statement C C over Peano Arithmetic such that 𝖯𝖠 + C {\sf PA}+C interprets A A .

arxiv-2206-09298.title: GMM based Multi-stage Wiener Filtering for Low SNR Speech Enhancement
arxiv-2206-09298.description: Abstract This paper proposes a single-channel speech enhancement method to reduce the noise and enhance speech at low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) levels and non-stationary noise conditions. Specifically, we focus on modeling the noise using a Gaussian mixture model (GMM) based on a multi-stage process with a parametric Wiener filter.

arxiv-2212-10880.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ping He, Yu Zhou, Bin Zhu. Let 𝒟 \mathcal{D} be a Hom-finite, Krull-Schmidt, 2-Calabi-Yau triangulated category with a rigid object R R . Let Λ = End 𝒟 ⁡ R \Lambda=\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal{D}}R be the endomorphism algebra of R R . We introduce the notion of mutation of maximal rigid objects in the two-term subcategory R ∗ R ⁡ [ 1 ] R\ast R[1] via exchange triangles, which is shown to be compatible with mutation of support τ \tau -tilting Λ \Lambda -modules.

arxiv-2306-02085.title: Polynomial systems admitting a simultaneous solution
arxiv-2306-02085.creator: Austin Conner, Mateusz Michałek, Michael Schindler, Balázs Szendrői
arxiv-2306-02085.description: Abstract . We provide a description of a complete set of generators for the ideal that serves as the resultant ideal for n n univariate polynomials of degree d d . Our generators arise as maximal minors of a set of cascading matrices formed from the coefficients of the polynomials, generalising the classical Sylvester resultant of two polynomials. 1.

arxiv-2307-11488.title: Bi-Equivariant Fibrations
arxiv-2307-11488.creator: Pavel S. Gevorgyan
arxiv-2307-11488.description: Abstract . The lifting problem for continuous bi-equivariant maps and bi-equivariant covering homotopies is considered, which leads to the notion of a bi-equivariant fibration. An intrinsic characteristic of a bi-equivariant Hurewicz fibration is obtained. Theorems concerning a relationship between bi-equivariant fibrations and fibrations generated by them are proved. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 54H15, 55R91 1.

arxiv-2402-01869.title: InferCept : Efficient Intercept Support for Augmented Large Language Model Inference
arxiv-2402-01869.creator: Reyna Abhyankar, Zijian He, Vikranth Srivatsa, Hao Zhang, Yiying Zhang
arxiv-2402-01869.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Reyna Abhyankar, Zijian He, Vikranth Srivatsa, Hao Zhang, Yiying Zhang. Large language models are increasingly integrated with external environments, tools, and agents like ChatGPT plugins to extend their capability beyond language-centric tasks. However, today’s LLM inference systems are designed for standalone LLMs. They treat each external interaction as the end of LLM generation and form a new request when the interaction finishes, causing unnecessary recomputation of already computed contexts, which accounts for 37-40% of total model forwarding time.

arxiv-2411-08633.title: Quasi-two-dimensional Turbulence
arxiv-2411-08633.creator: Alexandros Alexakis
arxiv-2411-08633.description: Abstract Many fluid-dynamical systems met in nature are quasi-two-dimensional : they are constrained to evolve in approximately two dimensions with little or no variation along the third direction. This has a drastic effect in the flow evolution because the properties of three dimensional turbulence are fundamentally different from those of two dimensional turbulence.

arxiv-2506-13715.title: Sharpness-Aware Machine Unlearning
arxiv-2506-13715.creator: Haoran Tang, Rajiv Khanna
arxiv-2506-13715.description: Abstract We characterize the effectiveness of Sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) under machine unlearning scheme, where unlearning forget signals interferes with learning retain signals. While previous work prove that SAM improves generalization with noise memorization prevention, we show that SAM abandons such denoising property when fitting the forget set, leading to various test error bounds depending on signal strength.

However, access for this population to professional service providers is limited. Therefore, there is an increasing need for access to mental health services and new mental health care resources tailored to adolescents.

pmc-10650661.title: Immunometabolic Profiling of Chronic Subdural Hematoma through Untargeted Mass Spectrometry Analysis: Preliminary Findings of a Novel Approach
pmc-10650661.creator: Maria Kipele, Michael Buchfelder, R. Verena Taudte, Andreas Stadlbauer, Thomas Kinfe, Yavor Bozhkov
pmc-10650661.description: Objective: Metabolomics has growing importance in the research of inflammatory processes. Chronic subdural hematoma (cSDH) is considered to be, at least in part, of inflammatory nature, but no metabolic analyses yet exist. Therefore, a mass spectrometry untargeted metabolic analysis was performed on hematoma samples from patients with cSDH.

pmc-11353521.title: Deviation of the Nail Lamina after Unilateral Partial Matricectomy
pmc-11353521.creator: Álvaro Saura-Sempere, Rubén Sánchez-Gómez, José Manuel Reguera-Medina, Salvador Márquez-Reina, Rafael Rodríguez-León, Álvaro Gómez-Carrión
pmc-11353521.description: Deviation of the nail plate in the transverse plane has traditionally been regarded as a postoperative complication following the definitive surgical treatment of ingrown toenails, particularly when only a single nail fold is addressed. The quantification and longitudinal comparison of the operated versus non-operated nail folds could elucidate potential transverse deviations of the nail plate.

pmc-11454802.title: 6810 Successful Insulin Allergy Desensitization To Humalog During The Second Trimester Of Pregnancy
pmc-11454802.creator: Jairo Noreña, Susan Seav, Shirley Jiang, Sean McGhee, Marilyn Tan, Marina Basina
pmc-11454802.description: Disclosure: J. Noreña: None. S. Seav: None. S. Jiang: None. S. McGhee: None. M. Tan: None. M. Basina: None. pmc-11547948.title: Tree-based classification model for Long-COVID infection prediction with age stratification using data from the National COVID Cohort Collaborative
pmc-11547948.creator: Will Ke Wang, Hayoung Jeong, Leeor Hershkovich, Peter Cho, Karnika Singh, Lauren Lederer, Ali R Roghanizad, Md Mobashir Hasan Shandhi, Warren Kibbe, Jessilyn Dunn, National COVID Cohort Collaborative (N3C) Consortium
pmc-11547948.description: ObjectivesWe propose and validate a domain knowledge-driven classification model for diagnosing post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC), also known as Long COVID, using Electronic Health Records (EHRs) data.Materials and MethodsWe developed a robust model that incorporates features strongly indicative of PASC or associated with the severity of COVID-19 symptoms as identified in our literature review.

pmc-11602832.title: Association of Heterotopic Gastric Mucosa in the Upper Esophagus (HGMUE) with Pharyngolaryngeal Symptoms: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-11602832.creator: Xuanran Chen, Shunhai Zhou, Chaoyi Shi, Mingzhi Feng, GeSang ZhuoMa, Diyun Shen, Tianyue Wang, Jun Zhang
pmc-11602832.description: BackgroundHeterotopic gastric mucosa in the upper esophagus (HGMUE) is considered to be accompanied by pharyngolaryngeal symptoms, whereas the association strength between HGMUE and pharyngolaryngeal symptoms remains controversial. This study assessed the strength of the association between HGMUE and pharyngolaryngeal symptoms using a meta-analytic approach.

pmc-11619601.title: Inclisiran for the treatment of hypercholesterolaemia
pmc-11619601.creator: Joel C Marrs, Sarah L Anderson
pmc-11619601.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Inclisiran is a synthetic small interfering RNA (siRNA) that inhibits the production of proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin 9 (PCSK9) in hepatocytes by silencing the translation of PCSK9 mRNA. The result of this mechanism is a decrease in PCSK9 synthesis resulting in decreased degradation of the LDL receptor, leading to more LDL receptors being available to clear LDL cholesterol (LDL-C) from the circulation. Inclisiran received FDA approval in 2021 and EMA approval in 2020.

pmc-11700345.title: Assessment the Combining Medications with Tobacco during Water-Pipe Smoking among the University Students in Jordan
pmc-11700345.creator: Naeem Shalan, Yazun Jarrar, Wisam Nasser, Sura Al Zoubi, Qais Jarrar, Mohammad A Salahat, Batool Qutami
pmc-11700345.description: Background:Water-pipe smoking, popularly known as “hookah” or “shisha,” is a widespread social activity in the Middle East, involving the use of a water-filtered device to vaporize flavored tobacco. A concerning trend has emerged as individuals add various drugs to the tobacco mixture, complicating the health implications.

pmc-12424143.title: Global, regional and national epidemiology of acute myeloid leukemia (1990–2021): a statistical analysis of incidence, mortality, and DALYs
pmc-12424143.creator: Binghuo Wu, Fei Song, Xue Han, Minyi Zhao, Meijia Huang, Wenwen Zhang, Tian Tan, Yanju Gong, Chenhui Cao, Songtao Cheng
pmc-12424143.description: BackgroundThis study provides a comprehensive analysis of the global, regional, and national epidemiology of acute myeloid leukemia (AML) from 1990 to 2021, focusing on incidence, mortality, and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs).MethodsUsing data from the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) study, we investigated the trends and patterns of AML across 204 countries and territories during 1990 to 2021.

pmc-12640477.title: The polyploid continuum and the landscape of polyploid genomic variation
pmc-12640477.creator: Alex D. Twyford, Justin L. Conover, Jeff J. Doyle, Annaliese S. Mason, Douglas E. Soltis, Pamela S. Soltis, Jonathan F. Wendel
pmc-12640477.description: Polyploid research has traditionally distinguished between autopolyploids and allopolyploids on the basis of evolutionary origins, modes of inheritance, or chromosomal pairing behavior during meiosis. It has long been recognized, however, that a binary classification does not accurately reflect the complexity and diversity inherent to polyploid organisms, and that these definitions may be inadequate to capture biological diversity.

pmc-12757526.title: Anaphylaxis and pregnancy: Epidemiology, elicitors, and recurrences☆
pmc-12757526.creator: Luciana Kase Tanno, Pham Thao Van Luong, Megane Dieval, Caroline Dunoyer, Emma Di Meglio, Florent Fuchs, Nicolas Molinari, Isabella Annesi-Maesano, Pascal Demoly
pmc-12757526.description: BackgroundAnaphylaxis during pregnancy implies a risk to both mothers and newborns. However, limited data are available. Therefore, our aim is to explore patterns of hospital admissions diagnosed with anaphylaxis in pregnant women in France from 2012 to 2021, using a national hospital billing database and to evaluate potential determinants, trends and recurrences.

pmc-12808783.title: Integral Betti signatures of brain, climate and financial networks compared to hyperbolic, Euclidean and spherical models
pmc-12808783.creator: Luigi Caputi, Anna Pidnebesna, Jaroslav Hlinka
pmc-12808783.description: This paper extends the possibility to examine the underlying curvature of data through the lens of topology by using the Betti curves, tools of Persistent Homology. We show that low-dimensional Betti curve approximations effectively distinguish not only Euclidean, but also spherical and hyperbolic geometric matrices, both from purely random matrices as well as among themselves.

pmc-13077894.title: Cross-cultural adaptation and psychometric validation of the Indonesian version of the behavioral integrity scale for organizational settings
pmc-13077894.creator: Muhammad Syarif Hidayatullah, Anissa Lestari Kadiyono, Marina Sulastiana, Yus Nugraha
pmc-13077894.description: BackgroundLeadership integrity is crucial in collectivist and hierarchical societies, such as Indonesia, for fostering trust and achieving organizational success. In such a high-context culture, organizational leaders’ alignment between words and actions is highly valued. However, the availability of culturally adapted measures for assessing leaders’ behavioral integrity (BI) in this context remains limited, hindering both research and practice.

pmc-13312670.title: Relationships between vigorous physical activity and psychological complaints in adolescents: findings from 240,951 participants
pmc-13312670.creator: Mingjun Xia, Ping Wang, Bin Feng, Qingru Zhang, Jin Yan
pmc-13312670.description: Background and PurposeThis cross-sectional study explores the association between vigorous physical activity (VPA) and psychological complaints in adolescents. While psychological complaints are a crucial aspect of adolescent development, the role of VPA in relation to specific complaints remains unclear, as existing evidence is mixed and varies by symptom type.

pmc-13462315.title: Differential Neutrophil Responses to Smooth Titanium: A Double‐Edged Sword for the Abutment‐Gingival Interface (An In Vitro Study)
pmc-13462315.creator: Tian Xu, Tulio Fernandez-Medina
pmc-13462315.description: IntroductionThe role of immunity in the failure of implantable devices has been historically overlooked in implant dentistry. This study investigates how neutrophils and blood plasma proteins interacting with titanium (Ti) surfaces influence the early inflammatory response.MethodsThree distinct Ti surfaces (Ti‐320, Ti‐1200, and Ti‐4000) with varying roughness were prepared by serial grinding.

pmc-13678431.title: Epigenetic Regulatory Networks in Cardiac Fibrosis: Therapeutic Targets, Crosstalk, and Future Directions
pmc-13678431.creator: Yansheng Yao, Chongyu Shao, Haitong Wan
pmc-13678431.description: Cardiac fibrosis is a central driver of pathological cardiac remodeling and a critical risk factor for the progression to heart failure. Cardiac fibrosis may induce myocardial ischemia and hypoxia, impaired cardiac function, and arrhythmias, and is thereby intimately linked to escalating cardiac mortality. Epigenetic mechanisms serve as core drivers in both the initiation and malignant evolution of cardiac fibrosis.
